Doctor in pharmaceutical law and patient advocate. Elected board member of the French association Assedea. Deputy Chair since the general assembly of 26 August 2026, carrying the registry mission.
DysNet board · Thalidomide patient expert · Austria
Thalidomide survivor, co-founder of the Austrian thalidomide self-help group, former youth social worker in Vienna.

She is the patient coordinator of EX-Center in Solna, the Swedish knowledge and rehabilitation centre for children and adults with multiple limb deficiencies, which she helped found in 1993. She has been active in the Swedish Thalidomide Society since 1986 and was its Permanent Secretary from 2004 to 2006. She is herself a thalidomide survivor.
Past president of Raggiungere and of LEDHA; a career in sales management; parent of a daughter with dysmelia.
